content: The new dashboard load times are blazing fast! Loving the clean analytics layout.
Having trouble exporting custom CSV reports on the free plan. It throws a 500 error when filtering by date.
Pricing for the Pro plan feels a bit steep for small startup teams of under 5 members.
Mobile app crashes whenever I try to upload a customer screenshot on iOS 18.
The Ask LOOP AI feature is incredible! Saved our product team hours of manual feedback categorization.
Wish there was a direct Slack integration for instant customer support ticket notifications.
Great customer support team! Resolved our webhook authentication setup in less than 15 minutes.
Dark mode is fantastic! Would love to see customizable chart color palettes next.
Search bar in the inbox page feels sluggish when handling over 1000 items.
Onboarding checklist was super clear and allowed our team to go live in less than a day.
CSV importer fails silently when header columns are capitalized like 'Feedback' instead of 'content'.
The Voice-of-Customer PDF export is executive-ready and saved us so much time in our Q3 planning meeting.
Need role-based permissions so viewers cannot edit theme tags or clear inbox items.
App UI looks super modern and clean. Really enjoying the new theme tagging features!
Filtering by sentiment positive vs negative helps us immediately catch urgent bugs.
SSO SAML login configuration documentation is outdated and missing Okta configuration steps.
Loved the new search filters and bulk status actions!
Response time on customer tickets was over 48 hours over the weekend.
Adding Gemini AI model support makes classification super quick and accurate!
Would be awesome to have automated email alerts for spikes in negative sentiment.
Love how intuitive the theme breakdown charts are. Very easy to share with leadership.
Notification badge doesn't reset after reading all inbox items until page refresh.
Super smooth onboarding experience for our entire 20-person support department.
Exporting reports to PDF takes a bit longer than expected on large datasets.
Fantastic product! The automated sentiment score metric gives us immediate actionable insights.
